definitions.name: usp_StageInternetSales

definitions.content:
CREATE PROCEDURE [tarel_demo].[usp_LoadAnnualProductSales]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    INSERT INTO [tarel_demo].[AnnualProductSales]
    SELECT dates.[CalendarYear], product.[ProductKey], SUM(stage.[SalesAmount])
    FROM [tarel_demo].[InternetSalesStage] AS stage
    INNER JOIN [dbo].[DimDate] AS dates
        ON dates.[DateKey] = stage.[OrderDateKey]
    INNER JOIN [dbo].[DimProduct] AS product
        ON product.[ProductKey] = stage.[ProductKey]
    GROUP BY dates.[CalendarYear], product.[ProductKey];
END;
